agyos_skill.intent: Operational guide for startup founders navigating skill stacking, customer discovery, pricing psychology, MVP scoping, and investor narrative construction within the AGYOS ecosystem.
agyos_skill.instructions: A tactical handbook for technical founders, operators, and solo builders developing early-stage software products with AGYOS. Sustainable software ventures require four interlocking competencies: 1. Technical Execution: - Deep familiarity with contract-first API design, 5-Gate lifecycle governance, and monotonic test coverage. - Using AI agents as leveraged junior engineers rather than autonomous decision-makers without review. 2. Positioning & Direct Distribution: - Defining a specific audience niche with clear, jargon-free problem statements. - Establishing early distribution channels (communities, niche directories, Show HN) before writing backend code. 3. Pricing Psychology & Unit Economics: - Anchoring prices to customer outcome value rather than server cost or development hours. - Designing unambiguous billing tiers with straightforward usage limits. 4. Empirical Validation Loops: - Structured user interviews focused on historical user behaviors rather than hypothetical future interest. Apply these interview invariants during discovery: - Inquire About Past Actions: Ask "When was the last time you encountered this problem?" instead of "Would you pay for a tool that solves this?". - Quantify Current Workarounds: Determine how the user currently handles the issue (spreadsheets, manual labor, competing software). If no workaround exists, the problem is rarely acute. - Identify Willingness-to-Pay: If an interview subject affirms a problem is critical, request a concrete commitment (pre-order, deposit, or scheduled onboarding session). When scoping an initial release: 1. Identify the Single Load-Bearing Feature: - Strip away secondary admin dashboards, multi-tenant billing permutations, and advanced configuration toggles. - Retain only the singular workflow that delivers the core value proposition. 2. Enforce the 48-Hour Build Rule: - An MVP implementation plan must be executable within 48 engineering hours using proven boilerplate templates and free-tier infrastructure (`agyos-free-infra-catalog`). - Tier 1 (Free / Starter): Restricted by usage volume (e.g., 50 operations/month) or features, sufficient for individual evaluation without generating continuous operational loss. - Tier 2 (Professional): Positioned for commercial operators and growing teams; captures direct economic value.
